answers.core:
As an asset library this would require either:
- creating a scene serialization system (Heavy and will have to follow Godot updates).
- analyzing the script code to find the corresponding class (takes time).
- initializing the class (may cause Side effect).
- use relfection (not cool, can break in case of a private method get rename)
answers.workaround:
You can retrieve the Type behind the CSharp Script like this:
```cs
((GodotObject)csharpScript.New()).GetType()
```
But it requierd to initalize a new class.
